name: Crypto ATM and Kiosk Abuse
description: Virtual asset kiosks let users convert cash to crypto with light verification, making them attractive for scam victims forced to pay and for criminals placing cash. Risk centres on structuring, repeated high-value use, third-party direction and destination wallets tied to scams or mixers.

sources.text: FinCEN, Notice on Scams Involving Convertible Virtual Currency Kiosks (2025)
FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (2020)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)

indicators.ctx: The same user or phone number uses a kiosk several times in a short period at sizes below verification tiers.

indicators.name: Multiple users sending to the same destination wallet

indicators.canon: Older customer on first use with large amounts
indicators.desc: First-time, elderly user deposits large sums, often on a phone call, consistent with scam coercion.
indicators.ctx: First-time, elderly user deposits large sums, often on a phone call, consistent with scam coercion.

indicators.canon: Customer on a live call while transacting

indicators.fp: Customer using a guide or helper.
